policy.contentsRead: Only Go executable build metadata and raw bytes for binary hashes; runtime config/session/log contents never inspected. Directory digests contain names and stat metadata only.
policy.candidatePurpose: Recognized runtime/test fixture directories from source and Go-module-verified executables only.
policy.freshness: Root and all descendants require mtime and ctime older than cutoff.
policy.processes: Complete current-user lsof snapshot; any open path or cwd excludes its whole top-level temporary root.
policy.deletionRequirement: Refresh process handles and exact owner/device/inode/freshness immediately before deletion. A candidate is not authorization to delete a path that changed later.
policy.preserved: Source repositories/worktrees, standalone logs/reports/images/scripts/patches, unrecognized artifacts and keychain/notary files; symlink trees excluded.

note: Detailed candidate inventory was used for owner/inode/freshness/open-handle checks, then discarded after successful deletion. Source-like and ambiguous files remain preserved.
